scopeAudit.nonApplicableRemainder: All other strict accepted COL26.8 species assigned to Protists and Chromists remain outside this Cercozoa sidecar.
scopeAudit.boundary: This sidecar covers only strict accepted COL26.8 species descending from exact Cercozoa root 35. ITIS TSN 969919 is the exact accepted Cercozoa division, but its 2026-08-26 hierarchy has no accepted species descendants; broader ITIS lineages such as Fungi are intentionally excluded.

rootBoundaryAudit.decision: Use only the exact ITIS Cercozoa division TSN 969919. Do not substitute the older ITIS Fungi/Myxomycota hierarchy, which would create false cross-root coverage and duplicate unrelated taxa.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: The normalized COL name resolves to exactly one accepted ITIS Cercozoa species and directly equals that current ITIS name.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: The normalized COL name equals official ITIS invalid species-name evidence that resolves to exactly one accepted ITIS Cercozoa species.
statuses.ambiguous: The normalized exact evidence resolves to more than one accepted ITIS Cercozoa species TSN.
statuses.unmatched: No normalized exact accepted-name or official ITIS species-synonym evidence resolves to an accepted ITIS Cercozoa species.

matchingContract.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered or taxon-substituted matching is used.

deliveryContract.pagesLight: Pages needs only this small descriptor and may omit all row-level JSONL gzip shards.
deliveryContract.androidIosFull: Android and iOS complete-data inventories must include the descriptor and every listed row-level shard as the same checksum-addressed bytes.
deliveryContract.runtimeChange: This import deliberately changes no formal runtime or published release manifest.

generatedBy.deterministic: Pinned input checksums, fixed roots, exact SQL, exact representation-only normalization, code-unit ID ordering and deterministic gzip; no wall-clock fields or fuzzy matching.
